name: Family Budget
description: An envelope-lite family budget: money in, money out, categorized, one month at a time. Collaborators record income and expenses against colour-coded categories, set a monthly envelope per expense category, pick the currency symbol, and step through months to watch spending fill each bar; the first editor to open an empty budget gets a starter set of categories. Viewers and anyone the frame is published to see the month live and read-only. Categories and transactions are the space's budget_categories and budget_transactions tables, synced with the space; the currency symbol is a setting of the space.
